name: Nesaad still lives

date.label: The Burning Crusade · quest sequence; exact date unknown

summary: After the insignias are returned, Khay’ji receives word from another agent: Warp-Raider Nesaad survived. The assignment is now personal in a narrower sense: Khay’ji admits that his own attack failed and asks the seeker not to fail as he did. Nesaad is found in a small camp near the Heap. His death closes this immediate operation, but the quest’s next handoff is more revealing than a victory report: Khay’ji has another job, one that leads to Gahruj and the surveying equipment.
